brief.status: Requirements fixed for concept comparison; neither concept is selected, load-rated or approved for fabrication
brief.objective: Reduce the installed weight of the dance-floor and sheep-support systems while preserving the shared functional requirements

requirements.use: Dancing while the bus moves at up to 5 mph
requirements.deck_geometry_basis: Preserve current modeled footprint and height for both concepts; donor geometry remains unmeasured

requirements.road_removed: Roof deck/removable frame, sheep panels, projecting support assemblies, speakers and event equipment

budget_basis: User-controlled mass targets only. Shared reductions apply equally to both concepts. Four-station extra steel/joints is a NET allowance relative to the retained v5 members, including all reinforcement, replacements and differential fittings. Unlisted common systems remain excluded. No resulting value is a sized design or total vehicle weight.
